definitions.gloss: to run, to operate, to manage (a business)
definitions.explanation: To operate or manage a business, shop, or enterprise. Slightly more formal and literary than {経営|けいえい}する.

definitions.gloss: to conduct, to carry out (a ceremony or life activity)
definitions.explanation: To carry out or perform certain life activities, ceremonies, or rituals. Used in more literary or formal contexts.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{小|ちい}さな{店|みせ}を{営|いとな}んでいる。
examples.english: My father runs a small shop.

examples.japanese: この{旅館|りょかん}は{三代|さんだい}にわたって{家族|かぞく}で{営|いとな}んでいる。
examples.english: This inn has been run by the family for three generations.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}は{一人|ひとり}で{静|しず}かな{生活|せいかつ}を{営|いとな}んでいた。
examples.english: My grandmother lived a quiet life on her own.

examples.japanese: {葬儀|そうぎ}が{営|いとな}まれた。
{近所|きんじょ}の{寺|てら}で{法要|ほうよう}が{営|いとな}まれた。
examples.english: A memorial service was held at the neighborhood temple.

examples.japanese: {人々|ひとびと}は{自然|しぜん}の{恵|めぐ}みを{受|う}けながら、{慎|つつ}ましい{暮|く}らしを{営|いとな}んできた。
examples.english: People have lived modest lives, sustained by the blessings of nature.

notes:
Godan verb (む row: {営|いとな}む → {営|いとな}まない → {営|いとな}んで). Has a literary quality that makes it common in written language and formal descriptions.

Sense 1 typically takes a business or shop as its object. Sense 2 is used for ceremonies ({葬儀|そうぎ}を{営|いとな}む) and for broader descriptions of how one lives one's life ({生活|せいかつ}を{営|いとな}む).

The noun form {営|いとな}み means 'activity' or 'livelihood.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{商売|しょうばい}を{営|いとな}む — to run a business
・{店|みせ}を{営|いとな}む — to operate a shop
・{生活|せいかつ}を{営|いとな}む — to lead a life
・{葬儀|そうぎ}を{営|いとな}む — to hold a funeral
